where_to_buy: Small alimentari and enotecas around the lake

transport_options.description: Pay-as-you-go tickets for local buses and Lake Como boats (navigazione laghi); point-to-point tickets are better than a pass for a one-day lakeside trip unless all travel is by ferry
transport_options.cost: Bus ~€1.50–2.00 per ride; ferry €4–€15 depending on route

transport_options.description: Line C10 (Como – Menaggio – Colico) operated by ASF Autolinee along the western shore, roughly hourly; about 1 hr 15 min from Como to Tremezzo depending on traffic
transport_options.how_to_use: Buy tickets at ticket counters or directly from the driver

transport_options.description: Fast ferry (navetta veloce) from Como to Tremezzo, about 1 hr, departing roughly every 2 hrs; Como ferry terminal is 10 min from Como San Giovanni station
